latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Editor Dance Free — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release enabling automatic dance video editing with AI.
- Upload dance videos (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) for quick beat-synced edits and transitions.
- Streamlined setup with anonymous token creation and seamless cloud session management.
- Simple chat prompts trigger video upload, editing, export, and credit checks.
- Exports 1080p beat-matched videos in 1–2 minutes, ideal for social platforms like TikTok.
- Friendly error handling covers unsupported formats, file size limits, and token issues.
